subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive — proposed slots & attendee mapping
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena@inferlytics.com>, Tom Brooks <tom.b@inferlytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive — proposed slots & attendee mapping

Hi Lena / Tom —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call:
• Goal: validate production inference path for Inferlytics (real-time scoring + batch embedding pipelines) and confirm service-level expectations (p99 latency targets, expected QPS, and data retention constraints).
• Required attendees: your infra lead (who owns model hosting), an application engineer (to map request/response contracts), and our ML infra engineer + solutions engineer for a deep-dive.

To lock the 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (TDX) with the ML/infra team, can you confirm which of these windows works best in PDT? I’ll convert to UTC once we pick a slot.
1) Tue Oct 27 — 10:00–11:30 PDT (17:00–18:30 UTC)
2) Wed Oct 28 — 08:30–10:00 PDT (15:30–17:00 UTC)
3) Thu Oct 29 — 13:00–14:30 PDT (20:00–21:30 UTC)

Proposed attendee mapping from our side:
- Irene Choi (AM, sales lead) — meeting host / mutual action plan owner
- Priyom Das (AE) — commercial touchpoint
- Marcus Lin (Solutions Eng) — demo & infra runbook owner
- Naomi Feldman (ML Infra) — deep technical lead (model serving, KV cache, quantization discussion)

If you could reply with preferred slot and list of Inferlytics attendees (name + role + timezone), I’ll send a calendar invite and attach a short pre-call checklist. I’ve attached a one-page precall checklist for logistics and suggested pre-reads (tdx-precall-checklist.pdf).

Thanks —
Irene

--
Irene Choi

Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0149
From: Tom Brooks <tom.b@inferlytics.com>

Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive — proposed slots & attendee mapping

Irene — thanks for the recap and for the clear options. Wed Oct 28 08:30–10:00 PDT works best for us.

Attendees on our side:
- Tom Brooks — Head of Platform (tom.b@inferlytics.com) — Palo Alto / PDT
- Lena Park — Lead Data Engineer (lena@inferlytics.com) — Palo Alto / PDT
- Raj Patel — Infra Engineer (raj@inferlytics.com) — Bangalore / IST (will join remotely)

One ask: can we specifically cover how Redwood would handle short-lived traffic spikes and any fallback model variants you recommend for cost reliability tradeoffs? Also if Marcus/Naomi can allocate ~20 minutes to look at our current model size and estimated tokens per inference that’d be helpful.

I’ll leave it to you to share a calendar invite and agenda. We’ll invite our security lead only if anything on data retention or audit logs is needed — otherwise keep it lean.

Thanks —
Tom

Thanks Tom — locking Wed Oct 28 08:30–10:00 PDT. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event?eid=5f3b-inferlytics-tdx

Short agenda (attached as tdx-agenda-v1.md):
1) 08:30–08:40 — Introductions & success criteria (Irene + Tom)
2) 08:40–09:05 — Production footprint & architecture from Inferlytics (Lena, Raj)
3) 09:05–09:35 — Redwood serving runtime deep-dive (Naomi + Marcus) — kernels, KV cache, batching, and quantization recommendations
4) 09:35–09:50 — Scaling patterns & spike/fallback strategy — capacity tiers and model variant routing (Marcus)
5) 09:50–09:55 — Open technical questions / next engineering tasks
6) 09:55–10:00 — Mutual action plan / next steps (Irene + Priyom)

Precall asks (short):
- If possible, please share a sample request/response contract and approximate tokens per inference for your largest model (Raj or Lena) — paste to the HubSpot contact or bring to the call.
- Confirm whether Raj will join from IST and any timezone constraints.

Attachment: tdx-agenda-v1.md (short bullet agenda) and tdx-precall-checklist.pdf.

I’ve also added the mutual action plan to HubSpot under INF-2345: hubspot:contact/INF-2345 — will add a follow-up task to collect the sample contract.

See you Wed 08:30 PDT. I’ll include a dial-in and a short runbook link in the calendar invite description.

Best,
Irene
